result.response:
The claimant capture link (`/c/{token}`) has been rebuilt into a guided 8-step mobile-first flow matching the reference designs in `design-ref/capture-01-picker.png` through `capture-08-done.png`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Guided Multi-Step Flow ([capture.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/capture.html), [style.css](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/static/style.css))**:
   - **Look & Layout**: Mobile-first (390px) up to ~460px centered column; header with green "D" logo, "Demo Mutual Insurance", claim ID mono, thin progress bar (`#0f6b52`), and step subline ("Step N of 8: {title}"). Large inputs (radius 14px, 18px font), rounded option chips (selected state: light green `#e3f2ec` with `#0f6b52` border), and bottom bar with back button "‹", "Continue", and security footnote.
   - **Step 0 — What happened to your car?**: Grouped cards (Crash, Damage while parked, Something else) with icon, title, description, and auto-save footnote.
   - **Step 1 — When and where**: Date (required, default today), time, place, city, and state prefilled from policy.
   - **Step 2 — What happened**: Textarea statement (minimum 10 chars), and chips for other vehicle involved, police contacted, and drivable status.
   - **Step 3 — Where is the damage?**: Interactive top-down vehicle SVG outline with tappable zones that highlight amber when selected, bidirectional sync with 14 part chips, and "Another part..." note.
   - **Step 4 — Photos**: 4 cards (`plate`, `vin`, `damage`, `wide`) in exact order with number badges, live camera view via `getUserMedia` (rear camera), slot guide overlays, round shutter button, retake counter, live preview, canvas watermarking with session code, and "Checking…" state before thumbnail and reading status. No file inputs.
   - **Step 5 — Check**: Checklist of checks, review cards for prior steps with "Edit" jump links, and 4 thumbnails.
   - **Step 6 — Sign and send**: State fraud warning alert box, signer name, confirmation checkbox, and HTML5 canvas signature pad with "Clear" button.
   - **Step 7 & Complete Screen ([c_complete.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/c_complete.html))**: Green check circle, "Claim sent", claim ID card, and receipt confirmation.
   - **State Persistence**: Cached in `localStorage` per token to resume on reload, and saved to the server as steps complete.

2. **Backend Endpoints & Database ([main.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/main.py), [db.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/db.py), [checks.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/witnessed/checks.py))**:
   - Added `answers_json`, `signer_name`, `signature_image`, and `signed_at` columns to `claims` table.
   - Added `POST /c/{token}/answers` endpoint to validate and store incident details, mapping damaged parts to `claimed_damage_area` (`front`, `rear`, `left`, `right`) with priority tie-breaking.
   - Updated `POST /c/{token}/submit` to require answers, signature PNG data URL (<=300 KB), signer name, and confirmation; verifies all 4 photos; and includes answers, signer name, confirmation flag, and `signature_sha256` in the canonical sealed package.
   - Made `claimant_statement` and `claimed_damage_area` optional in `POST /console/new` and [console_new.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_new.html).
   - Reorganized Automobile Loss Notice in [console_claim.html](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/app/templates/console_claim.html) into 5 numbered sections: 1. What happened, 2. Your vehicle, 3. Damage, 4. Photos, and 5. Declaration.

3. **Tests ([test_capture_flow.py](file:///home/julian/Cursor%20work-space/witnessed-gemini/tests/test_capture_flow.py))**:
   - Added tests verifying: step titles presence without `type="file"`, parts mapping to claimed damage area, rejection of submissions lacking a signature, sealed package canonical verification including answers, and workspace declaration display with signer name.
